# Scenarios

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-scenario-docs.mjs from packages/core/src/scenarios.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

A scenario is a named, configurable starting point for a time-sensitive test. Every scenario, its parameters and their defaults are defined once, in the registry in [`packages/core/src/scenarios.ts`](../packages/core/src/scenarios.ts). This page is generated from it.

```ts
import { MockClock, resolveScenario } from '@workfonic/mockclock';

const clock = MockClock.scenario('payroll', { year: 2027, month: 1 }); // frozen at the scenario start
clock.scenario?.events;                                               // key instants, sorted
const resolved = resolveScenario('payroll', { year: 2027, month: 1 }); // the same data without a clock
```

- A scenario clock is **frozen** at `start` and uses the scenario's time zone for calendar arithmetic.
- Parameters may be passed typed (`{ month: 2 }`) or as strings (`{ month: '2' }`, as the CLI does). Lists accept arrays or comma-separated strings.
- Unknown parameters, out-of-range values, invalid dates and invalid time zones throw `InvalidScenarioParameterError`.
- `leadSeconds` controls how long before the key moment the clock starts.
- MockClock ships **no public-holiday data**. Holiday parameters default to example dates only.

CLI: `mockclock scenarios` lists them; `mockclock scenario <id> -p key=value` resolves one.

## `month-end`: Month-end

The last seconds of a month, rolling over into the first day of the next month.

Category: calendar

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `year` | integer (1970..9998) | `2026` | Calendar year. |
| `month` | integer (1..12) | `11` | Month (1-12) whose end is simulated. |
| `timeZone` | timeZone | `UTC` | IANA time zone the scenario is evaluated in. |
| `leadSeconds` | integer (0..2678400) | `60` | Seconds before local midnight of the next month at which the clock starts. |

With defaults: starts at `2026-11-30T23:59:00+00:00` (UTC).

| Event | Local time |
|---|---|
| Last day of month (2026-11-30) (`last-day`) | `2026-11-30T00:00:00+00:00` |
| First day of next month (2026-12-01) (`next-month`) | `2026-12-01T00:00:00+00:00` |

> The month has 30 days.

## `year-end`: Year-end

New Year rollover: December 31 into January 1.

Category: calendar

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `year` | integer (1970..9998) | `2026` | The year that is ending. |
| `timeZone` | timeZone | `UTC` | IANA time zone the scenario is evaluated in. |
| `leadSeconds` | integer (0..2678400) | `60` | Seconds before local midnight on January 1 at which the clock starts. |

With defaults: starts at `2026-12-31T23:59:00+00:00` (UTC).

| Event | Local time |
|---|---|
| December 31 (`last-day`) | `2026-12-31T00:00:00+00:00` |

## `leap-day`: Leap day

February 28 into February 29 and on to March 1 in a leap year.

Category: calendar

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `year` | integer (1972..9996) | `2028` | A leap year. |
| `timeZone` | timeZone | `UTC` | IANA time zone the scenario is evaluated in. |
| `leadSeconds` | integer (0..2678400) | `60` | Seconds before local midnight on February 29 at which the clock starts. |

With defaults: starts at `2028-02-28T23:59:00+00:00` (UTC).

| Event | Local time |
|---|---|
| February 29, 2028 (`leap-day`) | `2028-02-29T00:00:00+00:00` |
| March 1, 2028 (`march-1`) | `2028-03-01T00:00:00+00:00` |
| One year later (Feb 29 + 1 year) (`anniversary`) | `2029-02-28T00:00:00+00:00` |

|---|---|

## `subscription-renewal`: Subscription renewal

Monthly or yearly renewals anchored to a start date, including short months.

Category: billing

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anchorDate` | date | `2026-01-31` | Billing anchor (first charge) date. |
| `time` | time | `09:00` | Local time of day renewals run. |
| `interval` | enum (monthly / yearly) | `monthly` | Renewal interval. |
| `periods` | integer (1..120) | `4` | Number of renewals to generate. |
| `timeZone` | timeZone | `UTC` | IANA time zone the scenario is evaluated in. |
| `leadSeconds` | integer (0..2678400) | `60` | Seconds before the first renewal at which the clock starts. |

With defaults: starts at `2026-02-28T08:59:00+00:00` (UTC).

| Event | Local time |
|---|---|
| Subscription starts (2026-01-31) (`anchor`) | `2026-01-31T09:00:00+00:00` |
| Renewal 1 (2026-02-28) (`renewal-1`) | `2026-02-28T09:00:00+00:00` |
| Renewal 2 (2026-03-31) (`renewal-2`) | `2026-03-31T09:00:00+00:00` |
| Renewal 3 (2026-04-30) (`renewal-3`) | `2026-04-30T09:00:00+00:00` |
| Renewal 4 (2026-05-31) (`renewal-4`) | `2026-05-31T09:00:00+00:00` |

> Renewal dates are computed from the anchor date (anchor + n months), not from the previous renewal, so a Jan 31 anchor renews on Feb 28 and then Mar 31.

## `payroll`: Payroll processing date

Payroll cut-off a few business days before pay day, with pay day on the last business day of the month.

Category: payroll

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `year` | integer (1970..9998) | `2026` | Calendar year. |
| `month` | integer (1..12) | `11` | Payroll month (1-12). |
| `cutoffBusinessDays` | integer (0..15) | `3` | Business days before pay day that inputs lock. |
| `cutoffTime` | time | `17:00` | Local time the cut-off happens. |
| `weekendDays` | integer[] (1..7) | `6, 7` | ISO weekdays treated as the weekend (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday). |
| `holidays` | date[] | `(none)` | Non-working dates (YYYY-MM-DD). No holiday data is bundled. |
| `timeZone` | timeZone | `UTC` | IANA time zone the scenario is evaluated in. |
| `leadSeconds` | integer (0..2678400) | `60` | Seconds before the cut-off at which the clock starts. |

With defaults: starts at `2026-11-25T16:59:00+00:00` (UTC).

| Event | Local time |
|---|---|
| Payroll cut-off (2026-11-25 17:00) (`cutoff`) | `2026-11-25T17:00:00+00:00` |
| Pay day (2026-11-30) (`pay-day`) | `2026-11-30T00:00:00+00:00` |

> Pay day is the last business day of the month; weekends and listed holidays move it earlier.

## `midnight-rollover`: Midnight rollover

The final second of a local day, rolling over to the next date.

Category: calendar

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | date | `2026-11-30` | The local date that is ending. |
| `timeZone` | timeZone | `Asia/Kolkata` | IANA time zone the scenario is evaluated in. |
| `leadSeconds` | integer (0..2678400) | `1` | Seconds before local midnight at which the clock starts. |

With defaults: starts at `2026-11-30T23:59:59+05:30` (Asia/Kolkata).

| Event | Local time |
|---|---|
| Midnight, 2026-12-01 (`midnight`) | `2026-12-01T00:00:00+05:30` |

> UTC date and local date differ for part of the day in any zone that is not UTC.

## `dst-transition`: Daylight saving transition

Just before clocks spring forward (gap) or fall back (overlap) in a DST time zone.

Category: time-zone

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `year` | integer (1970..2100) | `2026` | Calendar year. |
| `timeZone` | timeZone | `America/New_York` | A time zone that observes daylight saving time. |
| `direction` | enum (forward / backward) | `forward` | "forward" = spring-forward gap, "backward" = fall-back overlap. |
| `leadSeconds` | integer (0..2678400) | `60` | Seconds before the transition at which the clock starts. |

With defaults: starts at `2026-03-08T01:59:00-05:00` (America/New_York).

| Event | Local time |
|---|---|
| Clocks spring forward 60 min (`transition`) | `2026-03-08T03:00:00-04:00` |
| One elapsed hour after the transition (`one-hour-later`) | `2026-03-08T04:00:00-04:00` |

> Local times inside the gap do not exist. MockClock resolves them per the disambiguation option (default: shift forward).

Category: calendar

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

| `timeZone` | timeZone | `UTC` | IANA time zone the scenario is evaluated in. |
| `leadSeconds` | integer (0..2678400) | `60` | Seconds before the end of the last business day at which the clock starts. |

With defaults: starts at `2026-12-24T23:59:00+00:00` (UTC).

| Event | Local time |
|---|---|
| Holiday: 2026-12-25 (`off-2026-12-25`) | `2026-12-25T00:00:00+00:00` |
| Weekend: 2026-12-26 (`off-2026-12-26`) | `2026-12-26T00:00:00+00:00` |
| Weekend: 2026-12-27 (`off-2026-12-27`) | `2026-12-27T00:00:00+00:00` |
| Next business day (2026-12-28) (`next-business-day`) | `2026-12-28T00:00:00+00:00` |

| Accrual 4: 8.00 days (2026-05-31) (`accrual-4`) | `2026-05-31T00:00:00+00:00` |

| Accrual 7: 14.00 days (2026-08-31) (`accrual-7`) | `2026-08-31T00:00:00+00:00` |
| Accrual 8: 16.00 days (2026-09-30) (`accrual-8`) | `2026-09-30T00:00:00+00:00` |
| Accrual 9: 18.00 days (2026-10-31) (`accrual-9`) | `2026-10-31T00:00:00+00:00` |

## `token-expiry`: Token expiry

An access token reaching its expiry time, with an optional clock-skew allowance.

Category: security

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issuedAt` | instant | `2026-11-25T12:00:00Z` | Token issue time (iat). |
| `ttlSeconds` | integer (1..31622400) | `3600` | Lifetime in seconds. |
| `clockSkewSeconds` | integer (0..3600) | `30` | Leeway a verifier allows after exp. |
| `leadSeconds` | integer (0..2678400) | `1` | Seconds before the token expires at which the clock starts. |

With defaults: starts at `2026-11-25T12:59:59+00:00` (UTC).

| Event | Local time |
|---|---|
| Token issued (iat) (`issued`) | `2026-11-25T12:00:00+00:00` |
| Token expires (exp) (`expires`) | `2026-11-25T13:00:00+00:00` |
| Leeway ends (+30s) (`skew-limit`) | `2026-11-25T13:00:30+00:00` |

> Token lifetimes are exact elapsed time, so they are unaffected by time zones and DST.

## `billing-retry`: Billing retry window

A failed payment retried on a schedule, then the subscription cancelled.

Category: billing

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `failedAt` | instant | `2026-11-30T09:00:00Z` | When the first charge failed. |
| `retryDays` | integer[] (1..60) | `1, 3, 7` | Days after the failure on which to retry. |
| `cancelAfterDays` | integer (1..90) | `10` | Days after the failure the subscription is cancelled. |
| `timeZone` | timeZone | `UTC` | IANA time zone the scenario is evaluated in. |
| `leadSeconds` | integer (0..2678400) | `60` | Seconds before the first retry at which the clock starts. |

With defaults: starts at `2026-12-01T08:59:00+00:00` (UTC).

| Event | Local time |
|---|---|
| Charge failed (`charge-failed`) | `2026-11-30T09:00:00+00:00` |
| Retry 1 (day 1) (`retry-1`) | `2026-12-01T09:00:00+00:00` |
| Retry 2 (day 3) (`retry-2`) | `2026-12-03T09:00:00+00:00` |
| Retry 3 (day 7) (`retry-3`) | `2026-12-07T09:00:00+00:00` |
| Subscription cancelled (day 10) (`cancelled`) | `2026-12-10T09:00:00+00:00` |
